title: asplenium filix-femina
intro: Asplenium filix-femina, commonly known as the Lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Aspleniaceae family. It is native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia, but has been naturalized in many other parts of the world. The Lady fern has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing coughs, and easing digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are believed to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
